name: feedback-ingestion
description: Ingests human-confirmed verdicts from writer review queue into ensemble.agent_stats. Enables Bayesian weight adaptation (Improvement 1) to converge. Wires the open feedback loop identified in audit.
author: librefang

steps.prompt_template: Read confirmed verdicts from writer.pending_review queue (human-approved items only).
steps.name: read-review-queue

steps.prompt_template: Ingest confirmed verdicts into ensemble.agent_stats, requiring minimum 2 independent reviews for borderline P_fake [0.45, 0.75] claims.
steps.name: ingest-to-ensemble-stats

steps.prompt_template: Trigger Bayesian weight recomputation when threshold is reached and quality threshold is met.
steps.name: trigger-weight-recompute

steps.prompt_template: Immutable log of the feedback ingestion batch and any weight changes.
steps.name: archive-feedback-record
